metadata.title: Integration Lifecycle Signaling

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for producing authoritative lifecycle state signals for system-to-system integrations.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Integration registries, ownership records, decommissioning workflows, and lifecycle state management systems.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Supporting Zero Trust pattern defining lifecycle state as an explicit trust input for integrations.

props.name: data-pattern
props.remarks: Defines integration lifecycle state as authoritative control data governing continued trust and participation.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Controls governing system lifecycle, ownership, and termination (PL, CM, MP families).

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Zero Trust guidance asserting that trust is revocable based on context and lifecycle.

metadata.remarks: Integration Lifecycle Signaling defines authoritative lifecycle states for integrations and emits trust signals based on those states. This pattern does not perform decommissioning, disablement, or enforcement actions.

components.title: Integration Lifecycle State Detection
components.description: Determines the current lifecycle status of an integration.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Integration lifecycle states and responsibilities are formally defined.

components.title: Lifecycle Trust Signaling
components.description: Signals lifecycle-driven trust degradation or revocation to downstream consumers.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Lifecycle state informs integration trust decisions.
